title: AllowDynamicProperties permits creating a dynamic property without deprecation

ground_truth.statement: The built-in AllowDynamicProperties attribute exempts this class from the dynamic-property creation deprecation introduced in PHP 8.2. The property write is legal and warning-free, while the unannotated control triggers a deprecation.

provenance.derivation: Upstream only declares an empty attributed class. Added real property creation and an unannotated negative control.

notes: This compares permissive language behavior with static property policies. All three tools flag line 7: PHPStan property.notFound, Psalm UndefinedPropertyAssignment, and Mago non-existent-property. These remain FP against the explicitly permissive runtime baseline, not automatically implementation bugs: AllowDynamicProperties suppresses PHP's deprecation, not necessarily an analyzer's stricter property-declaration policy.
